Dehydrated Red Onion Granules for Food Manufacturing and Export

Dehydrated red onion granules are small, dried pieces of red onion that give savoury onion flavour without the peeling, chopping and tears. Tradenest Naturals makes them from carefully selected red onions sourced from trusted growers, and processes them to keep the natural aroma and sweet-savoury taste. We supply bulk dehydrated onion granules to food manufacturers, seasoning companies, restaurants, distributors, importers and private label brands who need consistent quality and a reliable supply. Switching to granules removes the daily labour, handling and storage problems that come with fresh onions.

As a dehydrated onion granules supplier and dehydrated onion granules exporter from India, Tradenest Naturals handles standard orders, wholesale volumes, custom packaging and export documentation support. Industrial buyers can also look at related lines, including dehydrated white onion granules, onion flakes, onion powder and custom onion seasoning blends built for a particular formulation.

Product Overview

Our red onion granules go through cleaning, sorting, trimming, cutting, controlled dehydration, cooling, grading and sieving to give a uniform, free-flowing product. They rehydrate during cooking or can be added straight into dry mixes. Compared with fresh onions, they are easier to store, need far less handling, create less waste and allow precise portion control.

The colour ranges from pale pink and lavender to light reddish-brown, depending on the onion variety, maturity, drying conditions and granule size. The flavour is clearly onion: savoury, mildly sweet and moderately pungent, with natural variation from crop to crop. No artificial colours, flavours or preservatives are added unless a custom formulation has been agreed.

Manufacturing and Processing

Tradenest Naturals follows set food-processing procedures to get even moisture reduction and accurate particle sizing. Raw onions are chosen for maturity, soundness, cleanliness and suitability for drying. After inspection, they are cleaned, trimmed, peeled where needed and cut to size. Controlled hot-air dehydration then removes the moisture while protecting the flavour and rehydration behaviour.

  • Raw material inspection and lot identification
  • Cleaning, trimming, peeling and size preparation
  • Controlled dehydration under monitored conditions
  • Cooling before packing to limit condensation and caking
  • Sieving and grading to the 16-26 mesh target range
  • Final inspection, packing, batch coding and traceability records

We are happy to discuss processing parameters if you have particular colour, aroma, rehydration or application requirements. Custom packing is available for industrial users and private label partners.

Typical Technical Specifications

The specifications below are our standard targets. Final values can vary slightly with the crop season, the grade and the agreed purchase specification. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation.

  • Product: Dehydrated red onion granules
  • Typical Mesh: 16-26 mesh
  • Typical Moisture: Not more than 8%
  • Typical Purity: Single-ingredient red onion, sorted and graded to the agreed specification
  • Form: Free-flowing dehydrated granules
  • Additives: No added artificial colours, flavours or preservatives in standard production
  • Color: Light pink to reddish-brown, with natural crop-to-crop variation
  • Origin: India

Applications

The granulated format doses accurately and spreads evenly, so it works well in both dry and wet manufacturing. Use it straight into the recipe, or soak it first when you want a softer onion texture. Main applications include:

  • Masala blends, curry powders, spice mixes and savoury seasonings
  • Instant noodles, soup premixes, stock powders and ready-to-cook meals
  • Snack seasonings for potato chips, namkeen, extruded snacks and popcorn
  • Burger patties, processed meats, plant-based proteins and stuffing mixes
  • Sauces, gravies, dips, marinades, chutneys and dressings
  • Bakery items such as savoury breads, crackers and filled pastries
  • Commercial kitchens, hotels, QSRs, cloud kitchens and large-scale catering
  • Private label dry mixes and custom food formulations

Buyer Benefits

  • Extended Storage Convenience: Low moisture gives a long-lasting, shelf-stable ingredient when stored correctly.
  • Reduced Labor Costs: No peeling, chopping or trimming, and none of the waste that comes with fresh onions.
  • Consistent Portion Control: Even granules make weighing, blending and dosing simple at industrial scale.
  • Optimized Logistics: Dried onion takes up far less storage space and freight weight than fresh produce.
  • Year-Round Availability: Protects your production schedule from seasonal fresh onion price spikes and shortages.
  • Formulation Flexibility: Works on its own or combined with white onion granules, onion powder, garlic, herbs and spices.

Quality, Safety, and Documentation

Our quality routine covers raw material inspection, moisture control, foreign matter prevention, particle-size grading, pack integrity and batch traceability. Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter, and we only make claims we can back up. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Export documents, such as batch details, packing lists and destination-specific shipping papers, are prepared according to the order.

Please tell us about any allergen policies, residue limits, labelling rules, dietary requirements or import conditions before you confirm the order. Tradenest Naturals reviews each specification ahead of production so the product, packaging and paperwork all line up.

Packaging and Shelf Life

Standard packaging protects the granules from humidity, contamination, light and mechanical damage in transit and storage. Options include food-grade moisture-resistant inner liners, stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers and heavy-duty export bulk packaging. Private label and custom printed packaging can be arranged once artwork and materials are confirmed.

Shelf life is 12 months from the date of manufacture when the product stays sealed in suitable moisture-barrier packaging under cool, dry conditions. Each commercial pack is labelled with the product name, batch number, net weight, production date, best-before date, storage instructions and any required regulatory notices.

MOQ, Lead Time, Samples, and Quotations

The minimum order quantity (MOQ) for dehydrated red onion granules is 5 Kg. This suits trial runs, product development and first orders for a new market. Custom blends, retail pouches, printed packaging and OEM projects may need larger quantities, which we confirm after reviewing your specification.

Lead time depends on raw material availability, order volume, any testing you request, custom artwork and the export documents required, and we confirm it in each quotation. To request a sample or formal quote, please send your estimated volume, destination country, preferred packaging, end application, labelling instructions and any quality standards you work to, so our team can recommend the right grade.

Why Source from Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals brings ingredient manufacturing, bulk packing, private label support, custom formulation and export coordination together in one B2B supply model. We work with food processors, FMCG brands, importers, regional distributors and growing businesses that want practical ingredient solutions rather than rigid, one-size-fits-all products. We focus on consistent specifications, honest communication, responsive development support and dependable logistics.

Whether you need wholesale dehydrated onion granules for industrial production, small trial lots for R&D or a private label export programme, we can help you choose the right product and packaging. Contact Tradenest Naturals with your target specification to request samples, the product specification sheet and a tailored quotation.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for dehydrated red onion granules?

Orders start from 5 Kg, which is useful for trials and product development. Larger bulk supply, OEM and private label programmes can be planned on request.

What are red onion granules used for?

They are used in masala blends and spice mixes, instant noodles and soup premixes, snack seasonings for chips, namkeen and popcorn, burger patties and plant-based proteins, sauces, gravies, dips and chutneys, savoury bakery items, and in commercial kitchens, hotels, QSRs and catering.

Can I get a different granule size?

Our standard granulation is 16-26 mesh. If your recipe needs a different cut, ask us about our onion flakes, chopped onion or onion powder.

Do you offer private label packing and samples?

Yes. Tradenest Naturals offers OEM and private label packing, and samples are available on request so you can check colour, aroma and performance in your own formulation.
